answer: New identities start in a 12-epoch probation and must lock 6 POA, which unlocks only after a clean voyage through it. Each extra identity from the same funding cluster adds 2 POA to every member's bond, so n fakes cost about 6n + n(n-1) POA. A relic of old activity earns no shortcut. Auditors sample 10% of bonds each epoch, trace funding paths on the ledger like a glacier core, and slash 60% of any cluster they find.
